name: mask-write-back-refusal
assertion: A subject whose read disposition on a field is transformed or withheld cannot mutate that field: evaluateSecurityWrite and the write routine refuse without an original read disposition or declared blind-write permission, including a proposed value equal to the mask output; absent column UPDATE privilege is a direct-SQL negative control; RETURNING old/new never discloses the pre-image of a masked or withheld column; failed checks leave no effects.
